items.news_summary: GitHub 於 10 月 5 日發布 Copilot 更新，旨在提升跨帳戶與環境的使用便利性，並增強對代理程式存取權限及工作管理的控制。

items.title: Google's Gemini 4 「Carbon」型號據稱可媲美 Anthropic's Opus 5.5 編碼效能 / Google's Gemini 4 "Carbon" model is reportedly matching Anthropic's Opus 5.5 coding performance

sources.title: Google's Gemini 4 「Carbon」型號據稱可媲美 Anthropic's Opus 5.5 編碼效能 / Google's Gemini 4 "Carbon" model is reportedly matching Anthropic's Opus 5.5 coding performance
sources.title_zh: Google's Gemini 4 「Carbon」型號據稱可媲美 Anthropic's Opus 5.5 編碼效能
sources.title_en: Google's Gemini 4 "Carbon" model is reportedly matching Anthropic's Opus 5.5 coding performance
sources.title_original: Google's Gemini 4 "Carbon" model is reportedly matching Anthropic's Opus 5.5 coding performance
sources.summary: Gemini 4 Argon isn't even widely available yet, and rumors about a more powerful version codenamed Carbon are already making the rounds. According to Business Insider, one employee compared Carbon's coding abilities to Anthropic's Opus 5.5. Meanwhile, new modes are showing up in the Gemini app and AI Studio, suggesting Google is gearing up for the broader Gemini 4 launch. The article Google's Gemini 4 "Carbon" model is reportedly matching Anthropic's Opus 5.5 coding performance appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: Gemini 4 Argon 甚至尚未廣泛推出，有關代號為 Carbon 的更強大版本的傳言就已經流傳開來。根據《Business Insider》報導，有一位員工將 Carbon 的編碼能力比擬為 Anthropic's Opus 5.5。同時，新的模式也開始出現在 Gemini 應用程式與 AI Studio 中，這暗示 Google 正在為更廣泛的 Gemini 4 發布做準備。這篇題為 Google's Gemini 4 「Carbon」型號據稱可媲美 Anthropic's Opus 5.5 編碼效能的文章最初發表於 The Decoder。
